cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I accept your apology for breaking the vase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. The vase was cheap. You let me blame the dog for three days.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the dog and me which part of that embarrassment we deserved.

mechanism: A accepts its former pupil apology for a broken object then redirects repair toward letting A falsely blame the dog.
confusable: Not demanding a pricier replacement: A explicitly shifts apology from object loss to withheld truth and misdirected blame.
comparison: Emotional silence after absence versus blame preserved after breakage.
seedUse: D219 vase/replacement/cheap/dog three days/embarrassed; S05 owned-mistake lesson.
